summary: Adds four corpus-informed finding-model amendments: a P1 evidence gate that downgrades unsupported P1s to P2, a question kind that excludes suspicion from the verdict, self-reported evidence style with a speculative prompt caution, and occurrence collapse that tracks repeated patterns as one finding and resolves only when all occurrences are gone.

pr_summary.headline: Adds four corpus-informed finding-model amendments: a P1 evidence gate that downgrades unsupported P1s to P2, a question kind that excludes suspicion from the verdict, self-reported evidence style with a speculative prompt caution, and occurrence collapse that tracks repeated patterns as one finding and resolves only when all occurrences are gone.

walkthrough.text: severity_gate.py introduces the mechanical P1 gate: any P1 without a non-empty failure_scenario is replaced with a P2 via dataclasses.replace and marked severity_downgraded, so the correction is a visible record rather than a silent rewrite.

finding_parser.py wires the gate into parse_findings, guards against str(None) turning a null failure_scenario into the truthy literal 'None', and skips the gate entirely when severity_override is set (author-declared policy, not model output).

FindingKind.QUESTION is excluded from derive_readiness_verdict, _severity_counts, every prompt scope, and the resolve_bullet_finding same-file fallback, with tests confirming a P1-labelled question leaves a READY verdict.

Occurrence collapse tracks a repeated pattern as one FindingRecord; partial progress shows occurrence_count / occurrence_total; a round that omits the occurrence list inherits prior locations rather than falsely marking progress.

66 new or extended tests cover gate downgrade, whitespace-only evidence, question exemption from verdict and prompts, occurrence deduplication, state round-trips, and degradation for every new field on malformed input.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: No P1 or P2 findings. One P3 test gap: the new behavior in github_render._severity_counts (question exclusion from p1/p2/p3 display counts) and the inline question/downgraded wiring in github_sticky._run_record (lines 1516-1517) are not exercised by any test in this diff. Pre-existing tests in test_github_sticky_mission_control.py use FindingKind.QUESTION but do not assert on RunRecord p1/p2/p3 counts, so the regression surface is uncovered.

file_assessments.overview: New module implementing the P1 evidence gate: downgrades P1 findings without a concrete failure_scenario to P2 and exposes count/describe helpers for renderer surfaces.
Wires the P1 gate into parse_findings, adds normalize_finding_kind and normalize_evidence_style, and guards against str(None) bypassing the gate via a truthy failure_scenario literal.
Extends ReviewFinding with kind, failure_scenario, severity_downgraded, evidence_style, and occurrences fields, plus all_occurrences and is_question computed properties.

Extends FindingRecord with kind, occurrences, occurrences_total, and severity_downgraded, with occurrence_count/occurrence_total/occurrences_addressed properties and serialization that omits the anchor occurrence to keep the blob minimal.
New model for a single file:line location of a repeated pattern, with parse_occurrences that drops non-string files and deduplicates via dict.fromkeys.
Propagates kind/occurrences/severity_downgraded through _current_records and _merge_pair, implements the silence-is-not-progress rule, and excludes questions from derive_verdict.
Adds prompt_findings to filter out questions before counting or rendering, appends SPECULATIVE_NOTICE to speculative finding blocks, and enumerates all occurrences in _occurrence_lines.
Excludes questions from derive_readiness_verdict's severity set and from resolve_bullet_finding's exact-match return path, with an explicit None when all exact matches are questions.
Adds question exclusion to _severity_counts so displayed p1/p2/p3 tallies match the derived verdict.
Adds questions and downgraded fields to _run_record's RunRecord construction, recording per-run severity inflation metrics alongside the severity distribution.
Adds questions and downgraded integer fields to RunRecord with zero defaults and full serialization round-trip.
New StrEnum with FINDING (default) and QUESTION members.
New StrEnum with DIFF_LOCAL (default), CROSS_FILE, and SPECULATIVE members.
Adds kind, failure_scenario, evidence_style, and occurrences to the strict CLI schema so the transport boundary does not reject model-reported fields.
Advertises the four new finding-model fields in the model-facing schema example, with failure_scenario annotated as required for P1.
Adds P1 calibration guidance, question cap instruction, evidence_style guidance, linter-out-of-scope rule, and occurrence collapse instruction to the prompt rules.
Expands the 'Do NOT report' section with linter-scope details and adds a severity calibration block with the evidence gate, P1/P2 tie-break rule, and question escape hatch.
New 311-line test file covering gate downgrade, whitespace evidence, question exemption, override exemption, visibility helpers, malformed-input degradation, and RunRecord round-trips.

Adds 236 lines of occurrence-tracking tests: single-location, partial progress, pattern-level resolution, regression, question verdict exclusion, state round-trips, and silence-is-not-progress regression guard.
Adds 99 lines covering question exclusion from fix-all prompts and panels, speculative notice presence/absence, occurrence enumeration, and single-occurrence no-list guard.
Adds 59 lines covering question exclusion from verdict, question-only READY verdict, and exact-line question reference returning None instead of falling back to a same-file finding.
Adds structural tests verifying all four #1925 fields appear in the CLI schema items properties and are not listed in required.
Adds content checks for P1 calibration language, code-smell scope, schema field presence, and output rules question cap and occurrence instructions.
Adds failure_scenario to the sample P1 finding payload so the response fixture remains a valid P1 after the evidence gate activates.
Updates six severity normalization tests to supply failure_scenario so the P1 gate does not downgrade them before the normalization assertion runs.
Re-exports the two new enum types.
Re-exports FindingOccurrence.

findings.title: Questions/downgraded wiring in _run_record not tested
findings.description: github_sticky._run_record now populates RunRecord.questions via an inline sum comprehension (line 1516) and RunRecord.downgraded via count_downgrades (line 1517). Neither of these wiring paths has a test in this diff, so a mistake in the comprehension (e.g., wrong attribute) or a broken import of count_downgrades would go undetected. Similarly, the question exclusion added to github_render._severity_counts (line 211-212) has no test: the displayed p1/p2/p3 tallies in the RunRecord could silently inflate when a question is also a P1 label, because no test checks that a question-only findings set yields {P1:0, P2:0, P3:0} from _severity_counts.
findings.cause: The new inline code at github_sticky.py:1516-1517 and the is_question guard in github_render.py:211-212 are new behavior added in this diff but absent from the diff's test additions. Pre-existing tests in test_github_sticky_mission_control.py use FindingKind.QUESTION but do not assert on p1/p2/p3 RunRecord field values after the change, leaving the regression surface uncovered.
findings.fix: Add a test that builds a ReviewResult with one question (kind=QUESTION, severity=P1) and zero regular findings, calls _run_record (or the full build_sticky_comment path), and asserts that the returned RunRecord has p1=0, p2=0, p3=0, questions=1, downgraded=0. A companion test with one genuine P1 (no failure_scenario, so downgraded=1) should assert downgraded=1, p2=1.
